request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:BATTLESHIP

layers.text: Recolour only the two flags: the blue flag on top of the lookout tower and the red flag on the mast both become hazard yellow rags, colour #fdd20f. Nothing blue and nothing red is left on the flags. Do not redraw anything else: keep the hull, the tin plates, the sails, the lookout tower, the barrels, the firework spark, the goblin, the colours, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
